## SAS Code

This is the way to display SAS code with syntax highlight by apply `{echo=TRUE, eval=FALSE, class='SAS'}` for code chunk:

```{class='SAS'}
data ae4;
	set ae3;
	if trtedt >. then trtend = trtedt + 28;
	if trtsdt > . then do;
		if trtsdt <= astdt <=trtend then trtemfl = "Y";
		else if astdt = . then trtemfl = "Y";
	end;
	drop trtsdt trtedt trtend;
	proc sort;
	by usubjid;
run;
```
